subject: Re: Status: eval results + backbone variance risk
body:
Wei, all — decisions ahead of the pre-read.

The pilot ships with one pinned backbone profile — the primary one from your evals — and profile switching stays an internal capability, not a user-facing option. The 91% citation-support number goes in the pre-read with the eval methodology attached.

Pilot scope: research mode plus the equity slice with sector guardrails, five bundled skills covering Idris's recurring report types; the auto-mode router stays off until we've seen real usage.

Leilani — production SSE deployment needs Zeke's sign-off, book it this week. Privacy review cleared Monday with one condition: agent logs retain cited-URL lists for 30 days max.

Pre-read goes out May 8; pilot starts the following week if the board doesn't object. Sharp work on the evals, Wei.

Anders
